paragraphs.text: Teacher is an unreleased acorn class for those who impart their knowledge on others.
Teacher was a creature type that was designed for Unglued 2: The Obligatory Sequel before it was canceled. It was for a card called Aerobics Instructor which represented a person teaching aerobics.
Teachers are common throughout the Multiverse and are also referred to as mentors, masters, or professors. Strixhaven , Tolarian Academy , and Tolaria West are magic schools with teachers.
